entities.summary: Elisabeth Dieringer-Granza is an Austrian politician from the Freedom Party of Austria (FPÖ). From April 2018 to April 2023 she was a member of the Carinthian State Parliament. Since 16 July 2024 she has been a member of the European Parliament.
